name: V3 ship sale authorized location acceptance

tests.name: Create explicit disposable black-market facility classification

data.sql: INSERT INTO porttypes(code,description,can_buy,can_sell,is_stardock,is_black_market) VALUES('V3_TEST_SHIPSALE_BLACKMARKET','V3 acceptance black market',TRUE,TRUE,FALSE,TRUE) ON CONFLICT(code) DO UPDATE SET is_black_market=TRUE,is_stardock=FALSE;

tests.name: Classify fixture port 1 as the black-market shipyard

data.sql: UPDATE ports SET porttype_id=(SELECT porttype_id FROM porttypes WHERE code='V3_TEST_SHIPSALE_BLACKMARKET') WHERE port_id=1;

tests.name: Read authoritative facility classifications for both sale ports

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT is_black_market::int FROM porttypes WHERE porttype_id=(SELECT porttype_id FROM ports WHERE port_id=1)), (SELECT is_stardock::int FROM porttypes WHERE porttype_id=(SELECT porttype_id FROM ports WHERE port_id=1)), (SELECT is_black_market::int FROM porttypes WHERE porttype_id=(SELECT porttype_id FROM ports WHERE port_id=2)), (SELECT is_stardock::int FROM porttypes WHERE porttype_id=(SELECT porttype_id FROM ports WHERE port_id=2));

tests.name: Authorize port 2 through its enabled shipyard inventory

data.sql: INSERT INTO shipyard_inventory(port_id,ship_type_id,enabled) SELECT 2,shiptypes_id,TRUE FROM shiptypes WHERE enabled=TRUE ORDER BY shiptypes_id LIMIT 1 ON CONFLICT(port_id,ship_type_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled=TRUE;

tests.name: Move seller and active ship into the black-market sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=2 WHERE name='ship_location_qa';

tests.name: Dock active ship at black-market port

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET ported=1 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='ship_location_qa');

tests.name: Create ordinary owned hull for black-market sale

data.sql: WITH player AS (SELECT p.player_id,p.ship_id,s.type_id,s.sector_id FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.name='ship_location_qa'), hull AS (INSERT INTO ships(name,type_id,sector_id,ported,holds,fighters,shields) SELECT 'V3 black-market sale hull',type_id,sector_id,1,10,0,0 FROM player RETURNING ship_id), owner AS (INSERT INTO ship_ownership(ship_id,player_id,role_id,is_primary) SELECT hull.ship_id,player.player_id,1,TRUE FROM hull CROSS JOIN player RETURNING ship_id) SELECT ship_id FROM owner;

tests.name: Sell ordinary hull at DB-classified black-market shipyard
Verify black-market sale and used inventory are attached to the classified facility

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN port_id=1 AND proceeds>0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipyard_used_inventory WHERE ship_id=@{black_market_sale_ship_id} AND port_id=1)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM ship_sale_audit WHERE sale_id=@{black_market_sale_id};

tests.name: Move player and active ship into the inventory-yard sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=3 WHERE name='ship_location_qa';

tests.name: Dock active replacement at inventory-authorized yard

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET ported=2 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='ship_location_qa');

tests.name: Create ordinary owned hull for inventory-authorized yard sale

data.sql: WITH player AS (SELECT p.player_id,p.ship_id,s.type_id,s.sector_id FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.name='ship_location_qa'), hull AS (INSERT INTO ships(name,type_id,sector_id,ported,holds,fighters,shields) SELECT 'V3 inventory-yard sale hull',type_id,sector_id,2,10,0,0 FROM player RETURNING ship_id), owner AS (INSERT INTO ship_ownership(ship_id,player_id,role_id,is_primary) SELECT hull.ship_id,player.player_id,1,TRUE FROM hull CROSS JOIN player RETURNING ship_id) SELECT ship_id FROM owner;

tests.name: Sell ordinary hull at inventory-authorized shipyard
Verify inventory-authorized yard sale and durable used inventory

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN port_id=2 AND proceeds>0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipyard_used_inventory WHERE ship_id=@{inventory_yard_sale_ship_id} AND port_id=2)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM ship_sale_audit WHERE sale_id=@{inventory_yard_sale_id};
